 Alabama Crimson Tide No. 18 Alabama basketball is back in Coleman Coliseum on Monday night to host the Oakland Golden Grizzlies out of the Horizon League. 
--> No. 18 Alabama basketball is back in Coleman Coliseum on Monday night to host the Oakland Golden Grizzlies out of the Horizon League. 
 Crimson Tide head coach Nate Oats has a long history with Oakland head coach Greg Kampe from Oats' days as a high school coach in the state of Michigan. Contrary to what you might think when you read the name, Oakland University is in Auburn Hills, Michigan, not California. This will be the second time the two have faced off since Oats arrived at Alabama with the last meeting occurring in 2021.

 Last Meeting : The Crimson Tide dominated the Golden Grizzlies 86-59 on Nov. 19, 2021. Alabama guards Jaden Shackelford and Jahvon Quinerly combined for 39 points, eight rebounds, four assists, three blocks and two steals. Charles Bediako scored 12 points and added three blocks, while J.D. Davison filled the stat sheet with 10 points, seven rebounds and five assists. Jamal Cain scored 31 points for Oakland, with the next top scorer contributing eight points.
